integrity: The claim is proved symbolically from the definition of a positive square point, compactness of finite-dimensional unit spheres, and the exact norming faces of ell_1^n functionals on the cube. No computational search or unverified numerical evidence is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is finite-dimensional and specific to the real spaces ell_infinity^n. It does not address infinite-dimensional ell_infinity(Gamma), approximate positive-square points, or the distinct Delta- and nabla-point notions.
title: Positive square points of \(\ell_\infty^n\) are exactly cube-face centers
